decision.strategy: Trade based on RSI momentum signals. Enter long positions when RSI shows oversold conditions (below 30) in an uptrend, and short when overbought (above 70) in a downtrend. Use the 15m timeframe for precise entries and 1h for trend confirmation. Exit when RSI returns to neutral (45-55) or hits opposite extreme.
decision.risk_guidelines: Max position size 5% of capital. Max leverage 10x. Stop trading after 3 losses in a day or 5% daily drawdown.
decision.additional_context: I prefer catching big moves over frequent small trades. The account typically holds 1-3 positions at a time.
